speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me if these bumps appear in crops, where new ones seem to emerge in waves while older ones fade? Do you notice any tiny, thread-like tracks on the skin or a central burr-like dot where the bug enters?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient complains of a pruritic rash on both upper extremities that has been present for 5 months. She notes that the rash occasionally worsens but has not completely resolved at any point. She denies any recent illnesses and mentions that she has not started any new medications or come into contact with any new substances that she is aware of.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Demodex folliculitis. Given the chronicity of the rash on the upper extremities and the description of pruritus, I am requesting images of the affected areas to visualize the characteristic follicular papules and potential thread-like tracks.
